verdict.rationale: Jules takes a submitted task, or a GitHub issue labelled "jules", and generates a plan that you review and approve before any code changes. That turns a described bug or feature into a scoped implementation plan, and a community user reports non-developer customers successfully creating their own PRs this way. missing for 10: explicit documentation that input can be free-form plain language, detail on how plans are scoped or broken down, independent hands-on corroboration of plan quality.
